description: The QSPI -> SD card configuration mirror (GIGA/Opta 4.4.3+): op status (default), config (mirror the configuration now), web (configuration + web UI folders), adopt (adopt a foreign card: write mirror.tag, then mirror). Needs an SD card and MYIO_WRITE=admin for the actions.
name: myio_fm_sync
title: Internal flash -> SD mirror
